Multiple Chart Types in R

How to design figures with multiple chart types in R.

Chart Types versus Trace Types

Plotly’s figure data structure supports defining subplots of various types (e.g. cartesian, polar, 3-dimensional, maps etc) with attached traces of various compatible types (e.g. scatter, bar, choropleth, surface etc). This means that Plotly figures are not constrained to representing a fixed set of “chart types” such as scatter plots only or bar charts only or line charts only: any subplot can contain multiple traces of different types.

Multiple Trace Types with Plotly

Every trace type has its own add_<type>() function (add_bar(), add_scatter(), …), so it is easy to start with a figure containing only traces of a given type, and add traces of another type.

library(plotly.core)

data <- data.frame(
  Fruits = c("apples", "bananas", "oranges"),
  Line = c(1, 3, 2),
  Bar = c(2, 1, 3)
)

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_bar(x = ~Fruits, y = ~Bar, name = "Last Year") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~Fruits, y = ~Line, mode = "lines", name = "This year") |>
  update_layout(
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "Amount"),
    legend = go_legend(title = go_legend_title(text = "<b> Time Period </b>"))
  )

Line Chart and a Bar Chart 

library(plotly.core)

data <- data.frame(
  X = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  Line = c(1.5, 1, 1.3, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9),
  Bar = c(1, 0.5, 0.7, -1.2, 0.3, 0.4)
)

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_bar(x = ~X, y = ~Bar) |>
  add_scatter(x = ~X, y = ~Line, mode = "lines+markers")

A Contour and Scatter Plot of the Method of Steepest Descent 

library(plotly.core)
library(jsonlite)

urlfile <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/steepest.json"
data <- fromJSON(url(urlfile))
X <- data[["contour_x"]][, ]
Y <- data[["contour_y"]][, ]
Z <- data[["contour_z"]][, , ]

go_figure() |>
  add_contour(x = X, y = Y, z = Z, showscale = FALSE) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = data$trace_x,
    y = data$trace_y,
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = "steepest",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(color = "black"),
    line = go_scatter_line(color = "black")
  ) |>
  update_layout(showlegend = FALSE)

Reference

See go_bar(), go_scatter() and go_contour() for more information and attribute options!
